copy.curiosityHook: When two perfectionists decide firearms are the only answer to their grievances, how far does their volatile crusade go?
copy.description: Bonded by drugs, sex, and meticulous habits, Nadine and Manu navigate a volatile reality where every obstacle is met with gunfire. Directed by Coralie Trinh Thi and Virginie Despentes, this French crime thriller moves fast.
copy.vibeSummary: Heavy, rapid, and fiercely tense; an intense solo watch defined by uncompromising grit and danger.
copy.whyWatch: At a lean 77 minutes, it delivers an abrasive, uncompromising crime thriller driven by lethal impulse and raw defiance, bypassing conventional storytelling limits.

allowedMaterial: Nadine and Manu as central characters
